<document id="savings-rate-change-2026">
Savingsˆrateˆchange,ˆJuneˆ2026ˆOnˆJuneˆ1,ˆ2026,ˆweˆchangedˆtheˆratesˆonˆSavingsˆPockets.ˆHereˆareˆtheˆoldˆandˆnewˆrates.ˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆBeforeˆ|ˆFromˆtheˆchangeˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ0.75%ˆ|ˆ0.50%ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ2.50%ˆ|ˆ2.00%ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ4.10%ˆ|ˆ3.75%ˆ|ˆ##ˆWhyˆOurˆsavingsˆratesˆfollowˆwiderˆinterestˆrates,ˆwhichˆcameˆdownˆoverˆtheˆpastˆyear.ˆWeˆkeptˆtheˆgapˆbetweenˆplansˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆneedˆtoˆdoˆNothing.ˆYourˆpocketsˆstartedˆearningˆtheˆnewˆrateˆautomatically.ˆInterestˆearnedˆbeforeˆtheˆchangeˆwasˆcalculatedˆatˆtheˆoldˆrate.ˆ##ˆNoticeˆWeˆemailedˆeveryˆmemberˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆtheˆchange.ˆ##ˆBalanceˆcapˆTheˆcapˆdidn'tˆchange.ˆPlanˆratesˆapplyˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆ##ˆThinkingˆaboutˆswitchingˆplans?ˆTheˆrateˆyouˆearnˆdependsˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆUpgradingˆtakesˆeffectˆimmediately,ˆsoˆyourˆpocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆhigherˆrateˆtheˆsameˆday.ˆCompareˆplansˆinˆtheˆappˆbeforeˆyouˆdecide.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="savings-apy-plus-v2">
SavingsˆrateˆonˆPlusˆOnˆtheˆPlusˆplan,ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆearnˆ2.00%ˆAPY,ˆeffectiveˆJuneˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆ##ˆDetailsˆ-ˆTheˆrateˆappliesˆtoˆcombinedˆpocketˆbalancesˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆAnythingˆaboveˆearnsˆ0.10%ˆAPY.ˆ-ˆInterestˆcompoundsˆdailyˆandˆisˆpaidˆmonthly.ˆ-ˆYourˆmainˆbalanceˆdoesn'tˆearnˆinterest.ˆMoveˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆpocketˆtoˆearnˆit.ˆ-ˆThere'sˆnoˆminimumˆbalanceˆandˆnoˆlimitˆonˆwithdrawals.ˆ##ˆRatesˆareˆvariableˆWeˆmayˆchangeˆtheˆrate.ˆWe'llˆemailˆyouˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆaˆdecrease.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆstartˆearningˆTapˆSavings,ˆthenˆNewˆpocket,ˆandˆmoveˆmoneyˆinˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆinˆandˆoutˆisˆinstantˆandˆfree.ˆInterestˆforˆeachˆmonthˆisˆpaidˆintoˆtheˆpocketˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆchangeˆplansˆYourˆpocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆnewˆplan'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆUpgradesˆtakeˆeffectˆrightˆawayˆandˆdowngradesˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆ##ˆEarnˆmoreˆPremiumˆmembersˆearnˆ3.75%ˆAPYˆonˆtheˆsameˆbalance.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="savings-apy-basic-v2">
SavingsˆrateˆonˆBasicˆOnˆtheˆBasicˆplan,ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆearnˆ0.50%ˆAPY,ˆeffectiveˆJuneˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆ##ˆDetailsˆ-ˆTheˆrateˆappliesˆtoˆcombinedˆpocketˆbalancesˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆAnythingˆaboveˆearnsˆ0.10%ˆAPY.ˆ-ˆInterestˆcompoundsˆdailyˆandˆisˆpaidˆmonthly.ˆ-ˆYourˆmainˆbalanceˆdoesn'tˆearnˆinterest.ˆMoveˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆpocketˆtoˆearnˆit.ˆ-ˆThere'sˆnoˆminimumˆbalanceˆandˆnoˆlimitˆonˆwithdrawals.ˆ##ˆRatesˆareˆvariableˆWeˆmayˆchangeˆtheˆrate.ˆWe'llˆemailˆyouˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆaˆdecrease.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆstartˆearningˆTapˆSavings,ˆthenˆNewˆpocket,ˆandˆmoveˆmoneyˆinˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆinˆandˆoutˆisˆinstantˆandˆfree.ˆInterestˆforˆeachˆmonthˆisˆpaidˆintoˆtheˆpocketˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆchangeˆplansˆYourˆpocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆnewˆplan'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆUpgradesˆtakeˆeffectˆrightˆawayˆandˆdowngradesˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆ##ˆEarnˆmoreˆPlusˆmembersˆearnˆ2.00%ˆAPYˆonˆtheˆsameˆbalance.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
